title: Existence of Kraus decomposition in infinite dimension via strongly-convergent direct process tomography
summary: An algorithm is presented for Kraus decomposition of a completely positive operator over separable (countably-infinite-dimensional) Hilbert spaces, together with an elementary proof that the generated sum convergences in strong-operator topology. This improves on the standard, nonconstructive, proof by fusing the abstract problem with practical process tomography. Kraus operators are generated one-by-one, each having one more guaranteed zero matrix entry than the previous one.
